items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had a singer named Rutherford

ctx.x: Snub Mosley joined the band about a month later. Snub Mosley played trombone. So we worked on that job and we played requests for the people, we played a lot of beautiful, sweet music, we played a little jazz, we played a wide variety of music at this particular club. And the band became a favorite around Cleveland, Ohio.

We worked hard, and rehearsed every week to try to improve the band and keep the patrons coming. We used the same style of cabaret as we did at Mammy Louise's Creole Garden. We had a singer named Rutherford, he had a rich, golden voice, baritone voice, and he could sing "Old Man River" and make you cry.

We had several great singers, that worked at this particular club. And I can remember one lady dancing, her name was Catherine, they called her Blondie. She was the wife, now, of Count Basie. We had a beautiful relationship with the owner of the club, and with all the employees there, during our tenure at the Furnace Nightclub.
